description.value: Red Robin is a well-known casual dining chain specialising in gourmet burgers and bottomless steak fries, with a full bar and a broad menu that includes veggie options, family bundles, and shareable appetizers. The Maple Ridge location sits on Lougheed Highway in a commercial complex near Golden Ears Provincial Park, placing it along a popular cycling corridor in the eastern Fraser Valley. Takeout and delivery are available, making it a practical calorie stop for riders tackling longer routes through the region.
